detail.longDescription: An interesting talk about the impact of LLM in the Linux Kernel security, by Greg KH, from Kernel Recipes 2026. It's not technical, talks about the real impact of LLM in the security of the OS and how AI companies' marketing exaggerates everything out of proportion. https:// m.youtube.com/watch?v=NnV_cWeo o5Q&ra=m # OpenSource # linux # security
